# Lede theme

> Lede 0.7.2's docs for Lede theme, installed with it. Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/lede-theme.md

Lede's tokens as shadcn variables in four themes (`light`, `dark`, `light-hc` and `dark-hc`), with Tailwind v4's `@theme` mapping and dark variant, the `.text-*` type classes and the component and block styles. Import `styles/lede/index.css` after your shadcn globals.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @lede/lede-theme
```

The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.7.2/lede-theme.json.

## Files and exports

| Installs to | Import from | Exports |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `styles/lede/tokens.css` |  | Stylesheet |
| `styles/lede/components.css` |  | Stylesheet |
| `styles/lede/blocks.css` |  | Stylesheet |
| `styles/lede/index.css` |  | Stylesheet |
